what_changed: Reshaped the wide workbooks to one row per operator per month. No value changed.
why: One row must be one operator in one month.

what_changed: Kept each year's copy from the newest workbook that carries it; removed the duplicate copy.
why: Every year except 2026 appears in two workbooks; the copies agree in every cell where both hold a number.

what_changed: Dropped months that are blank for every operator (December 2026, November 2026).
why: They have not been reported yet, so they are not observations.

what_changed: Dropped operator-months with no wagering: Total Handle zero (96) or blank (18). Receipts and tax are zero or blank in all of them.
why: The question is about sportsbooks that are operating; these are months before launch, after stopping, or paused.

what_changed: Dropped the row with a negative Total Handle (Little Traverse Bay Bands of Odawa Indians, August 2023: -1,419.34).
why: A closing correction after the operator stopped, not a month of betting.

what_changed: Removed typed footnote markers from operator names (19 labels became 15 names) and added a short name for figures.
Kept the platform provider (brand) as printed on each year's sheet and added each operator's latest label as a second column.
why: Brand labels change across years; the operator is the stable key.

what_changed: Created operator type from the label of the tax column: commercial (210 rows), tribal (713 rows).
why: Operator type is not a column in the file.

what_changed: Converted the launch date from a spreadsheet day number in text to a date (one cell held text and reads as the same date as its other form).
No change: 50 months with negative gross receipts kept as reported.
why: A sportsbook can pay out more than it takes in a month.

what_changed: No change: tax or payment kept as reported, including 232 months with positive adjusted receipts and zero tax.
why: The reported figure is what was paid; it defines the yes-or-no target.

what_changed: Created: month_date, free_play_deduction (gross minus adjusted receipts), free_play_per_100, kept_per_100, paid_no_tax, log10_handle, months_active.
why: Needed by the problem statements; each is defined in the codebook.

what_changed: Added the flag lump_deduction = 1 where the deduction is more than a quarter of that month's handle. No value changed.
why: Free play can be claimed in a later month as a lump; the flag lets findings be checked with and without those months.

what_changed: Added the flag first_active_month = 1 for each operator's first month with wagering. No value changed.
why: First months are partial (January 2021 starts on the 22nd).

what_changed: Kept the rows; set free_play_deduction and free_play_per_100 to missing where adjusted receipts exceed gross receipts.
why: A negative amount is not free play and the file does not explain it.

what_changed: Kept the rows; set free_play_per_100 and kept_per_100 to missing where Total Handle is under $10,000.
why: Ratios on a few hundred dollars are not meaningful.

what_changed: Created prior-month versions (prior_free_play_per_100, prior_kept_per_100, prior_log10_handle, prior_paid_no_tax), filled only when the operator's previous calendar month is in the data (906 of 923 rows).
why: Things known at the start of a month, for the predictive statement.

what_changed: Gave columns plain lower-case names and fixed their order (28 columns). Dollar amounts are kept exactly as published, with no rounding.
